author: cairn
blurb: A project health snapshot: open work, completion, and risk.

definition.name: Project health
definition.description: Writes a project health note with completion, open work, and risks.
definition.instructions: Assess the project's health: completion rate (done vs total cards), open tasks by priority, any overdue or blocked work, and recent activity. Write (or update) a note titled 'Project health' with sections: Health (Good / At risk / Needs attention), Completion, Open work, Blocked & overdue, and Suggested focus.
